character: A two-mountain resort in Vermont's Mad River Valley (Lincoln Peak and Mount Ellen, linked by a long chairlift), owned by Alterra Mountain Company, with a mix of groomed runs and natural-snow tree and steep terrain.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at Lincoln Peak. Learning-area details were not researched — confirm at source.

source.note: SnowStash: "The 2025-26 season at Sugarbush ran from 6 December 2025 to 3 May 2026."

season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-09-30. OnTheSnow projects Nov 21, 2026 (a third-party projection, not an announcement). Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.
